facts.claim: Ruby Princess (Princess Cruises): Entered service 2008; 113,561 GT; 3080 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Crown class.
Ruby Princess is a Crown-class cruise ship operated by Princess Cruises, a subsidiary of Carnival Corporation & plc.
Delivered in 2008 by Italian shipbuilder Fincantieri, Ruby Princess also became the ninth and final Grand-class ship to join the Princess Cruises fleet.
